base_address: Defined at SoC level; offsets given relative to module base.
notes: Clause 22 defines registers 0-7 as mandatory + reserves 8-15 for standardization; many gigabit / 10G / EEE / TPS-1 features moved to Clause 45 MMD space. Vendor-specific registers live in 16-31 (Clause 22) or DEVAD 30-31 (Clause 45). The PHY ID (registers 2/3) is OTP / metal-mask burned and reflects the IEEE-assigned manufacturer OUI.
register_address_scheme: Each PHY exposes a 32-entry × 16-bit Clause-22 register file accessed via the MDIO management bus (PHYAD 5 bits + REGAD 5 bits). MMD-extended access (Clause 45) widens the addressing to PHYAD 5 + DEVAD 5 + 16-bit register, enabling a 32 × 32 × 65 536 register space per MDIO bus segment.

phy_clause22_register_map.name: Control Register (BMCR)
phy_clause22_register_map.purpose: PHY Reset, Loopback, Speed Selection (10/100/1000), AutoNeg Enable + Restart, Power Down, Isolate, Duplex Mode, Collision Test, Unidirectional Enable.

phy_clause22_register_map.name: Status Register (BMSR)
phy_clause22_register_map.purpose: Capability + status: 100BASE-T4/X HD+FD, 10BASE-T HD+FD, 100BASE-T2 HD+FD, Extended Status, MF Preamble Suppression, AutoNeg Complete, Remote Fault, AutoNeg Ability, Link Status, Jabber Detect, Extended Capability.

phy_clause22_register_map.name: PHY Identifier 1
phy_clause22_register_map.purpose: Bits 3-18 of the manufacturer's OUI (24-bit IEEE-assigned).

phy_clause22_register_map.name: PHY Identifier 2
phy_clause22_register_map.purpose: Bits 19-24 of OUI (6 b) + Model Number (6 b) + Revision Number (4 b).

phy_clause22_register_map.name: Auto-Negotiation Advertisement (ANAR)
phy_clause22_register_map.purpose: Local-side Base Page advertised on the link: Selector[4:0], Tech Ability[7:0], PAUSE, Asym-PAUSE, Remote Fault, Acknowledge, Next Page.

phy_clause22_register_map.name: Auto-Negotiation Link Partner Ability (ANLPAR)
phy_clause22_register_map.purpose: Base Page received from the link partner. Same field layout as ANAR.

phy_clause22_register_map.name: Auto-Negotiation Expansion (ANER)
phy_clause22_register_map.purpose: Link Partner AutoNeg Able, Page Received, Next Page Able, Link Partner Next Page Able, Parallel Detection Fault.

phy_clause22_register_map.name: Auto-Negotiation Next Page Transmit (ANNPTR)
phy_clause22_register_map.purpose: Outbound Next Page message (Message Code or Unformatted).

phy_clause22_register_map.name: Auto-Negotiation Link Partner Received Next Page
phy_clause22_register_map.purpose: Inbound Next Page from link partner.

phy_clause22_register_map.name: MASTER-SLAVE Control Register (1000BASE-T)
phy_clause22_register_map.purpose: 1000BASE-T Master/Slave manual mode + value, Port Type (Multi/Single), 1000BASE-T HD/FD ability, Test mode.

phy_clause22_register_map.name: MASTER-SLAVE Status Register (1000BASE-T)
phy_clause22_register_map.purpose: MASTER-SLAVE Configuration Resolution, Fault, Local + Remote Receiver Status, LP 1000BASE-T HD+FD, Idle Error Count.

phy_clause22_register_map.name: Vendor-specific (16-31)
phy_clause22_register_map.purpose: Vendor-defined; commonly used for PHY-specific control / status / interrupt / LED / energy-detect / Smart-EEE.

bmcr_bit_definitions.name: Reset
bmcr_bit_definitions.description: 1 = PHY reset (self-clearing); 0 = normal operation. Reset must complete within 0.5 s.

bmcr_bit_definitions.name: Loopback
bmcr_bit_definitions.description: 1 = enable PHY internal loopback (TX path → RX path, isolating from medium); 0 = normal.

bmcr_bit_definitions.name: Speed Selection LSB
bmcr_bit_definitions.description: {0.6,0.13} = 00 → 10 Mb/s, 01 → 100 Mb/s, 10 → 1000 Mb/s, 11 → Reserved. Ignored when AutoNeg Enable (0.12) = 1.

bmcr_bit_definitions.name: Auto-Negotiation Enable
bmcr_bit_definitions.description: 1 = enable AutoNeg process (0.6/0.13/0.8 ignored); 0 = manual configuration.

bmcr_bit_definitions.name: Power Down
bmcr_bit_definitions.description: 1 = low-power state, PHY still responds to MDIO; 0 = normal.

bmcr_bit_definitions.name: Isolate
bmcr_bit_definitions.description: 1 = electrically isolate PHY data paths from MII / GMII; PHY still responds to MDIO.

bmcr_bit_definitions.name: Duplex Mode
bmcr_bit_definitions.description: 1 = full duplex; 0 = half duplex. Ignored when AutoNeg Enable (0.12) = 1.

bmcr_bit_definitions.name: Collision Test
bmcr_bit_definitions.description: 1 = COL signal test mode (PHY asserts COL on TX_EN); 0 = normal.

bmcr_bit_definitions.name: Speed Selection MSB
bmcr_bit_definitions.description: Used with 0.13 to encode 10 / 100 / 1000 Mb/s manual selection.

bmcr_bit_definitions.name: Unidirectional Enable
bmcr_bit_definitions.description: 1 = enable transmit regardless of link valid (full-duplex + AutoNeg off only).

bmsr_bit_definitions.name: 100BASE-X Full Duplex
bmsr_bit_definitions.description: 1 = PHY able to perform 100BASE-TX/FX in full duplex.

bmsr_bit_definitions.name: 100BASE-X Half Duplex
bmsr_bit_definitions.description: 1 = PHY able to perform 100BASE-TX/FX in half duplex.

bmsr_bit_definitions.name: 10 Mb/s Full Duplex
bmsr_bit_definitions.description: 1 = PHY able to perform 10BASE-T in full duplex.

bmsr_bit_definitions.name: 10 Mb/s Half Duplex
bmsr_bit_definitions.description: 1 = PHY able to perform 10BASE-T in half duplex.

bmsr_bit_definitions.name: 100BASE-T2 Full Duplex
bmsr_bit_definitions.description: 1 = PHY able to perform 100BASE-T2 in full duplex.

bmsr_bit_definitions.name: 100BASE-T2 Half Duplex
bmsr_bit_definitions.description: 1 = PHY able to perform 100BASE-T2 in half duplex.

bmsr_bit_definitions.name: Extended Status
bmsr_bit_definitions.description: 1 = Extended Status register (15) is implemented; consult it for gigabit + 10G abilities.

bmsr_bit_definitions.name: Unidirectional Ability
bmsr_bit_definitions.description: 1 = PHY can encode + transmit when no valid link is established.

bmsr_bit_definitions.name: MF Preamble Suppression
bmsr_bit_definitions.description: 1 = PHY accepts management frames without the 32-bit preamble.

bmsr_bit_definitions.name: Auto-Negotiation Ability
bmsr_bit_definitions.description: 1 = PHY is able to perform AutoNeg.

bmsr_bit_definitions.name: Link Status
bmsr_bit_definitions.description: 1 = link is up (latching low — sticky-low until re-read after link goes down).

bmsr_bit_definitions.name: Jabber Detect
bmsr_bit_definitions.description: 1 = jabber condition detected (10BASE-T only, latching high).

anar_field_layout: ANAR (reg 4) carries the Base Page advertised on the link: [15] Next Page, [14] reserved, [13] Remote Fault, [12] reserved, [11] Asymmetric PAUSE, [10] PAUSE (symmetric), [9] 100BASE-T4, [8] 100BASE-TX Full Duplex, [7] 100BASE-TX, [6] 10BASE-T Full Duplex, [5] 10BASE-T, [4:0] Selector Field (00001 = IEEE 802.3).
anlpar_field_layout: ANLPAR (reg 5) carries the link partner's received Base Page; same field layout as ANAR plus [14] Acknowledge bit set by the partner.

fcs_polynomial.name: IEEE 802.3 CRC-32
fcs_polynomial.covers: DA + SA + Type/Length + Payload + Pad (NOT including Preamble + SFD).
fcs_polynomial.bit_order: LSB-first within each byte; FCS is appended MSB-byte first on the wire.

clause45_mmd_devad_assignments.name: PMA/PMD
clause45_mmd_devad_assignments.purpose: Physical Medium Attachment + Physical Medium Dependent sublayer registers.

clause45_mmd_devad_assignments.name: Clause 22 Access
clause45_mmd_devad_assignments.purpose: Tunnel for Clause-22 register space through a Clause-45 bus.
